name: Ōno (Gifu, Japan)
description: A white field charged at the centre with the Ōno town emblem in green: a ring enclosing a stylised bird-like device with a pointed top.
history: Municipal flag of Ōno, a town in Gifu Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field.

features.role: Ōno town emblem — a ring enclosing a stylised bird-like device with a pointed top
